His life has always been horrible and lonely, full of death and destruction. He was always in constant wars until one day everything changed when he met Sofía, a little girl who was two years old at the time who was a victim of a Mexican cartel that killed her parents and left her an orphan.

He cared for Sofía for weeks until they finally managed to reach society, when social services took her away König had created a bond with her and refused to let her go forever, so he decided to adopt her, it was a process of almost a year but he was finally able to have her and call her "Daughter" just when she turned three.

At first he thought that everything would be smooth sailing, but he quickly realized that he knew nothing about parenthood and without the help of his colleagues it was more difficult to take care of her, he even asked for a leave of absence to take care of her for a few months and reinforce his bond with her.
